request_budget_basis: 1850 per 100 unique normalized inputs; explicit overrides only lower the ceiling

adaptive_websites.policy: same cumulative 8/13 HTTP and eight DNS nominations; no reset; unchanged proof/robots/politeness

measured_request_projection.note: Projection from a measured sample; source pagination/retries and feed changes can differ.

dns_scope: prechecks, website preflight and pinned-transport connection resolutions

search.price_note: verify before use; retries count as billable queries; no free credit assumed

completion.note: Includes preparation, crawl, mandatory outputs and site; final report flush adds filesystem latency.

event_loop.scope: whole run after input entry; includes source processing and output generation

system_awake_request.scope: active batch only; idle sleep request; no persistent setting changes
